```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(RColorBrewer)

```

Plate 1 - subset data - AvrStb6

```{r}
#---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
#---------------------------------------------------------

des <- read.csv("plate_layout.csv", header = TRUE)
data <- read.csv("plate_output.csv", header = TRUE)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert Time ("H:MM:SS") into numeric hours
#---------------------------------------------------------
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    H = as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", Time)),
    M = as.numeric(sub("^[0-9]+:([0-9]+):.*", "\\1", Time)),
    S = as.numeric(sub(".*:([0-9]+)$", "\\1", Time)),
    Time_hours = H + M/60 + S/3600
  ) %>%
  select(-H, -M, -S)   # clean-up

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Optional: choose a time window (example: 0–50 h)
#---------------------------------------------------------
data_subset <- data %>%
  filter(Time_hours <= 26)                           # adjust window as desired
# For 24–48 hours: filter(Time_hours >= 24 & Time_hours <= 48)


#---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Select bacteria and treatments
#---------------------------------------------------------
selected_bacteria <- c(
  "Pseudomonas sp.", "Rahnella sp.","Enterobacter sp.","Flavobacterium sp.","Curtobacterium sp.","Pantoea sp."
)

selected_treatments <- c("mock", "Melittin", "AvrStb6_1E4", "AvrStb6_1A5")

des_subset <- des %>% 
  filter(bacteria %in% selected_bacteria) %>%
  filter(treatment %in% selected_treatments)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Tidy data and join metadata
#---------------------------------------------------------
It <- data_subset %>%
  gather(key = "Well", value = "OD", colnames(data_subset)[!colnames(data_subset) %in% c("Time","Time_hours")]) %>%
  left_join(des_subset[, c("well", "bacteria", "treatment")],
            by = c("Well" = "well")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bacteria))  # remove wells not in selected bacteria


#---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Calculate mean and SD per time point
#---------------------------------------------------------
Imean <- It %>%
  group_by(Time_hours, bacteria, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Reorganise and rename bacteria and treatments
#--------------------------------------------------------- 

Imean$bacteria <- factor(
  Imean$bacteria,
  levels = c(
    "Pseudomonas sp.", 
    "Rahnella sp.",
    "Enterobacter sp.",
    "Flavobacterium sp.",
    "Curtobacterium sp.",
    "Pantoea sp."
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Pseudomonas sp.", 
    "Rahnella sp.",
    "Enterobacter sp.",
    "Flavobacterium sp.",
    "Curtobacterium sp.",
    "Pantoea sp."
  )
)
Imean$treatment <- factor(
  Imean$treatment,
  levels = c(
    "mock",
    "Melittin",
    "AvrStb6_1E4",
    "AvrStb6_1A5"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "mock",
    "Melittin",
    "AvrStb6.1E4",
    "AvrStb6.1A5"
  )
)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot using Time_hours (clean readable x-axis)
#---------------------------------------------------------

# Create custom labels for facet titles
bacteria_labs <- c(
  "Pseudomonas sp."   = "italic('Pseudomonas')~'sp.'",
  "Rahnella sp."      = "italic('Rahnella')~'sp.'",
  "Enterobacter sp."  = "italic('Enterobacter')~'sp.'",
  "Flavobacterium sp."= "italic('Flavobacterium')~'sp.'",
  "Curtobacterium sp."= "italic('Curtobacterium')~'sp.'",
  "Pantoea sp."       = "italic('Pantoea')~'sp.'"
)

ggplot(Imean, aes(x = Time_hours, y = mean, group = treatment, color = treatment)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
                width = 0.2, size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ bacteria, labeller = as_labeller(bacteria_labs, label_parsed)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Time (hours)",
    breaks = seq(0, max(Imean$Time_hours), by = 12)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Treatment") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(y = "OD600") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
  )

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save high-resolution figure
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("All_Antimicrobial_assay_24h.png", width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 1200)


```
